items.html: *AK includes AB, SAG, MA, and BON in his self, and each of these four is comprised of all four. Lights also come out of him outward, which are his branches. And the AB is in his Mochin (1), corresponding to AA and Aba of Atzilut. And above his Galgalta there is in him a likeness of the discernment of Atik of Atzilut. And his SAG is from the Ozen [ear] downward to his Tabur, and it corresponds to Bina of Atzilut. And his MA and BON are from his Tabur downward, corresponding to ZON of Atzilut.
